column1: # Bank 35 (tiles 0x6F4EDC-0x6F615C): one-glyph 16-row cells: equipment slot icons (white boxes) and the kanji
# digits used for every stat number (bare index-2 glyphs), plus 禄高/万石, あなたが/は/番/!! and 連撃 (below).
# Not seen in game (no single-player scene shows them; most likely the link mode's ranking/income readout, which
# needs a second GBA). Each pair of 16-row cells is drawn as one 32-row label, assuming the game places the
# cells end to end as it does the digits: 禄高 N 万石 -> "Koku N 0,000", あなたが/は N 番 !! -> "You're No. N !!"
# (番 blank: no suffix glued onto a number). 354-400 (!!, dots) are kept.
